The Household Hunger Scale (HHS) is a food deprivation indicator developed by USAID’s Food and Nutrition Technical Assistance Project (FANTA). It measures the severity of hunger in a household based on experiences of food deprivation over the past 30 days by asking whether the household had no food to eat, or if any member went to bed hungry, or went a whole day and night without eating due to a lack of resources. 

HHS is required in areas/for populations with high levels of food insecurity, as it allows differentiation between IPC Phase 4 and 5, while being less suitable for differentiation between less severe levels of food insecurity. It can never stand alone but needs to be collected in combination with other food security indicators.

More details on the indicator can be found here: https://vamresources.manuals.wfp.org/docs/household-hunger-scale-hhs

 
# Indicator Calculation 

## HHS ( IPC and general)

```{r}

# Food01 - HHSNoFood 	‘In the past [4 weeks/30 days], was there ever no food to eat of any kind in your house because of lack of resources to get food?’ 
# Food01b - HHSNoFood_FR	‘How often did this happen in the past [4 weeks/30 days]?’ 
# Food10a- HHSBedHung - 	‘In the past [4 weeks/30 days], did you or any household member go to sleep at night hungry because there was not enough food?’ 
# Food10b - HHSBedHung_FR	‘How often did this happen in the past [4 weeks/30 days]?’ 
# Food11a  - HHSNotEat	‘In the past 4 weeks (30 days), did you or any household member go a whole day and night without eating anything because there was not enough food?’ 
# Food11b - HHSNotEat_FR	‘How often did this happen in the past [4 weeks/30 days]?’. 


##Response options 

#Food01b	1	Rarely, for example once or twice in the past 30 days
#Food01b	2	Sometimes, for example three to ten times in the past 30 days
#Food01b	3	Often, for example more than ten times in the past 30 days

main$HHSNoFood <- main$Food01a

main$HHSNoFood_FR <- main$Food01b

main$HHSBedHung <- main$Food10a

main$HHSBedHung_FR <- main$Food10b

main$HHSNotEat <- main$Food11a

main$HHSNotEat_FR <- main$Food11a


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    HHSQ1 = case_when(
      HHSNoFood_FR == 1 ~ 1,
      HHSNoFood_FR == 2 ~ 1,
      HHSNoFood_FR == 3 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    HHSQ2 = case_when(
      HHSBedHung_FR == 1 ~ 1,
      HHSBedHung_FR == 2 ~ 1,
      HHSBedHung_FR == 3 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    HHSQ3 = case_when(
      HHSNotEat_FR == 1 ~ 1,
      HHSNotEat_FR == 2 ~ 1,
      HHSNotEat_FR == 3 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )


```

```{r}


##Add variable labels

var_label(main$HHSQ1) <- "Was there ever no food to eat in HH?"
var_label(main$HHSQ2) <- "Did any HH member go sleep hungry?"
var_label(main$HHSQ3) <- "Did any HH member go whole day without food?"



main <- main %>%
  mutate(HHS = HHSQ1 + HHSQ2 + HHSQ3)

var_label(main$HHS) <- "Household Hunger Score"

summary(main$HHS)

main <- main %>%
  mutate(HHSCat = case_when(
    HHS <= 1 ~ 1,
    HHS <= 3 ~ 2,
    HHS >= 4 ~ 3
  ))

var_label(main$HHSCat) <- "Household Hunger Score Categories"

```

```{r}
main$HHSCat <- labelled(
  main$HHSCat,
  labels = c("Little to no hunger" = 1,
             "Moderate hunger" = 2,
             "Severe hunger" = 3)
)


table(main$HHSCat)



main %>%
  count(HHSCat) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(HHSCat), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Household Hunger Category",
    y = "Number of Households",
    title = "Distribution of Household Hunger Categories"
  )

```

```{r}

FDS_XXX_202X_main <- main %>%
  as_survey_design(
    strata=samp_strat,
    weights = wgh_samp_pop_restr, # Specify the column with survey weights
    nest = TRUE              # Use TRUE if PSUs are nested within clusters )
  )


HHS <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07, HHSCat) %>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup()


HHS_strata <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(samp_strat, HHSCat) %>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup()


```



```{r}
 #Calculate HHS for IPC

main <- main %>%
  mutate(HHSCat_IPC = case_when(
    HHS == 0 ~ 0,
    HHS == 1 ~ 1,
    HHS %in% 2:3 ~ 2,
    HHS == 4 ~ 3,
    HHS >= 5 ~ 4
  ))

main$HHSCat_IPC <- labelled(
  main$HHSCat_IPC,
  labels = c(
    "No hunger in the household" = 0,
    "Little hunger in the household (stress)" = 1,
    "Moderate hunger in the household (crisis)" = 2,
    "Severe hunger in the household (emergency)" = 3,
    "Very severe hunger in the household (catastrophe)" = 4
  )
)

var_label(main$HHSCat_IPC) <- "Household Hunger Score Categories (IPC)"


main %>%
  count(HHSCat_IPC) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(HHSCat_IPC), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Household Hunger Category (IPC)",
    y = "Number of Households",
    title = "Distribution of Household Hunger Categories"
  )

```
